messages.text: The china man is in a small closet. To the south there is a plain door. The china man can see an old mans disguise.

messages.text: The china man opens the plain door.

messages.text:
The china man goes south.
 The sun streams in the two broad windows in your sitting room. There is a pipe rack to the right of the sofa. Bullet pock marks are the feature of one wall, and charts and diagrams fill another. An acid stained table sits in the corner. To the west there is your door. To the north there is a plain door. The china man can see an oil lamp, your armchair and watsons armchair. In watsons armchair there is Watson. Watson is carrying the daily chronicle.
